name: Duplicate child ids
documentation: NEGATIVE fixture. Two sibling collapsed subprocesses each declare a child with id "check" and a child flow with id "f_in". Every rule in rules.js walks one container at a time and sees nothing wrong, and the geometry never notices either because a collapsed subprocess draws no children -- but the emitted BPMN carries the same xsd:ID twice, which is document-wide unique by definition, so no tool loads the file correctly. NC06 is the code that names it. Kept under tests/fixtures/negative/ so net-check.test.js's directory-wide fence -- which scans the top level of tests/fixtures/ only and requires every fixture there to be a clean translation -- is never asked to hold a fixture that exists to be dirty.
